issues: A grey skeleton placeholder card on a light grey floor, with a debug title "CLONER DEPTH ECHO" in the corner: it read like a wireframe
The hero card covered only ~25% of the width in a mostly empty frame; the clone column collapsed into a stack of white sheets with almost no visible depth
Clones were just translucent copies of the same white card, fading with distance but with no light or layering, like a sticker array
Nothing remained after the merge: no number, no copy, so the "one = many" message never landed on screen
changes: Lime look (graphite black, neon yellow-green): the hero is an edge-function instance card "checkout-api" with a 132px p95 readout, a lime sparkline and eight region slots, turning "one = many" into "one deploy = eight regions"

Real 3D depth: perspective 1500 with the vanishing point at top left, so clones recede into a column just by translating in Z; distant clones fade, blur and lose their fill down to a lime outline like a C4D Cloner echo, each header showing its own region code

New 138f timeline: 16f entrance, 8f press anticipation, springs staggered 2.2f per clone, a 32f hold (2% push-in plus parallax drift), a synchronized 10f strong ease-in merge with speed blur, then a single 1.06 pulse and one rim glow
A 260px counter "xN" at bottom left rolls one step per clone (outgoing digit slides up and fades, speed-based vertical blur); on merge all eight region slots light up and the counter bounces
After the merge a 112px headline "Deploy once. / Run everywhere." rises into the freed top-left space, so the last frame is a complete poster of headline, counter and card
